analogy.rationale: Imidazoline receptor agonists share the imidazoline/alpha2-adrenergic binding pocket and are annotated to ADRA2A/B/C, so alpha-adrenergic antagonists and agonists should give the most similar transcriptional response; however, these cell lines express little ADRA2, so overall responses should be weak.
